svg.title: Kelvin — a name caught in the gravity of a black hole
svg.desc: The KELVIN title stretches into luminous filaments toward a relativistically ray-traced Kerr black hole. Letter contours echo, deform and shed fragments into the accretion flow. Green skills orbit inward. These cinematic typography effects are artistic; the disk is numerically ray traced.

g.text: Build useful things. Make the system work.
